description: Costs 2 credits. Pulls named fields off a page using CSS selectors and returns typed JSON. Each field reports found/missing/invalid_selector separately, so a partial result tells you which selector was wrong rather than failing the whole call. Requires Pro or above.

delay.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after load.

fields.description: Field name → { selector, type, attribute?, all? }. type is one of text, number, boolean, attribute, html, url, list. Set all:true to collect every match instead of the first. At most 100 fields.

url.description: The page to load. Must be http(s) and publicly reachable. Credentials in the URL (https://user:pass@host) are rejected; these tools capture as an anonymous visitor, so use the REST API directly if the page needs authentication.

waitForSelector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to appear before capturing.

name: domscout_extract_data
title: Extract structured data from a page
